summary: On paper this one is close: Minnesota's best edge is to keep the pocket clean (Minnesota ranks 11th in pressure rate, 22%), while Indianapolis's best counter is to tackle in space (Indianapolis' defense ranks 27th in YAC over expected per catch, -0.2 yds allowed). Under center, Daniel Jones ranks 20th of 26 in EPA per dropback; x-factor: Aaron Jones runs 0.4 yards per carry below expected, 21st of 29, and Indianapolis' run defense ranks 30th. The model favors Minnesota at 53%, mostly on home field (1.7 pts) and defensive injuries (1.0 pts).
